entry.name: poly
entry.description: Provides polyphonic voice-allocation by allocating data to different individual voices.

arguments.name: voices
arguments.description: Sets the number of voices to whichcan allocate notes (thus limiting the number of notescan hold at one time). If there is no argument present,will hold up to 16 notes.

arguments.name: steal-mode
arguments.description: If there is no second argument, or if the second argument is,sends any notes it cannot hold out the rightmost outlet. If there is a non=zero second argument,steals voices: whenreceives more notes than it has voices, it turns off the note it has held the longest and puts the new note in its place.
